name: Belvoir Terrace
description_short: An overnight summer camp for girls in grades 2 to 10 in Lenox, Massachusetts. Campers choose all their own classes in art, dance, music, theater and individual sports, taught by professional staff, in 6, 5 or 3 week sessions.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming classes with professional instruction, plus beach days at Camp Greylock.

source.title: CAMP LIFE at Belvoir Terrace - Summer Performing Arts Camp

warnings: This is a general 'Camp Life' page. It has no dates, prices or ages. Those are likely on https://www.belvoirterrace.com/dates-rates/.
Season year is based only on a 'Belvoir Terrace 2027' line in the footer.
This is a girls' camp ('Summer Girls Camp', 'Girls Theater Camp').
There is also a winter contact number: 212-580-3398. The address and 413 number shown are the summer contact.
A social media snippet mentions 'six weeks', but that isn't confirmed as the session length.
unknowns: 2027 session dates and lengths (see the Dates & Rates page)

low_confidence.quote: Fabulous delicious food, family style, complimented by bountiful salad bars.
outstanding facilities for art, dance, music, theater, tennis, swimming and more
